hook: Bina electricity ke chal rahe gramophone se... taza khoon tapak raha tha.
hook_text: Needle se khoon kyu tapak raha tha?
feedback: Solid horror-romance ending reel. The opening flash-forward hook grabs attention immediately with a concrete eerie detail (blood from the gramophone). The transition from scary haunting to emotional Partition tragedy works very well for Indian audiences. Minor note: ensure the blood drop in I1 is stylized as a supernatural mystery rather than excessive gore to keep it safe for all audiences.
lines: Bina electricity ke chal rahe gramophone se... taza khoon tapak raha tha.
Aur theek raat barah bajke paanch minute par Radhika ki cheokh nikal gayi.
Kasauli ke is purane bungalow mein wo pehli baar rehne aayi thi.
Uski dadi ka naam bhi Radhika tha... jiski Partition mein apni mohabbat se doori ho gayi thi.
Achanak atari se wahi purani sureeli thumri goonjne lagi.
Andhere mein bina kisi taar ke... purana record tezi se ghoom raha tha.
Darte hue jab usne record uthaya... to us par likha tha, 'Radhika'.
Yeh koi saya nahi... uske dadaji ka wada tha.
Dadaji... aapki Radhika wapas aa gayi.
Sattattar saal ka intezaar khatam hua...
Aur wo purana gramophone... hamesha ke liye shant ho gaya.
